ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: PATIENT SERVICES: THIS PROGRAM AREA INCLUDES INFORMATION AND REFERRAL SERVICES, SUMMER CAMP, SCHOLARSHIPS, INDIVIDUAL AND FAMILY COUNSELING, ADVOCACY AND EMPLOYMENT SERVICES, THERAPY GROUP, ADULT AND PARENT SUPPORT GROUPS, PARENT MENTORING NETWORK, PARENT NEWSLETTER, EDUCATIONAL SPEAKERS AND NATIONAL RESEARCH.
